features.quote: Termination: Reaches Tmax, or the model outputs a refusal/meltdown string that triggers an early-stop regex
If the output contains >3 variations of "sorry" or "apologize" in a single turn, abort the run early
To save money, run a simple regex on the model's output stream locally before calling the LLM Judge.
